behaviorChanges: the SessionStart directive hook (`autonomy-directive --hook`) now offers onboarding RESUMPTION on positive evidence: an interview-pending or source-unrendered un-adapted repo emits ONE root-resolved `onboarding_offer:` line (exit 0, never blocking). A zero-trace / unmanaged repo stays byte-silent, exit 0 (total containment). No new hook registration; the hook path never shells out.

the unmanaged no-adapter recovery command now names the REQUESTED target (`tautline init --target <target>`) instead of a hard-coded `.`, so a gate verb run with --target pointing elsewhere recovers the failed repo, not the current directory. Renders `.` only when target == cwd (unmanaged-at-target output stays byte-identical).

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Repinning below 0.14.7 removes the hook resumption offer (the hook returns to full silence in every un-adapted state) and restores the hard-coded `.` unmanaged recovery. No state migration.
grant-gh-project-scopes is carried forward from 0.10.3 (see requiredMigrations); a lane already on 0.10.3+ needs no action.
NOT WIP-safe only for the engine-gap carry-forward; the release's own change is a display/recovery-text improvement safe for lanes in progress.
